definitions.explanation: A period of six months; half of one year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧{半年|はんとし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been half a year since I came to Japan.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}⟦ぶり→ぶり：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met my friend for the first time in half a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦あと→あと：09580_ato⟧{半年|はんとし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'll graduate in another six months.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}⟦ごと→ごと：04012_goto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I get a health checkup every six months.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I only moved here half a year ago, so I still don't know this town well.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{半|はん}→半：noentry⟧ (half) + ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (year)

ALTERNATE READING: {半年|はんねん} is also used in some contexts (more formal).

TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧ (half a day)
- ⟦{半月|はんつき}→半月：15662_hantsuki⟧ (half a month)
- {半年|はんとし} (half a year)
- ⟦{一年半|いちねんはん}→一年半：noentry⟧ (one and a half years)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {半年|はんとし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in half a year)
- {半年|はんとし}⟦ぶり→ぶり：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (for the first time in half a year)
- {半年|はんとし}⟦ごと→ごと：04012_goto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (every half year)
- {半年|はんとし}⟦{後|ご}→後：noentry⟧ (half a year later)
